    Your café name

    Other students see this name on your profile, in both cafés. A first name or a nickname is enough (up to 24 letters).

    Your café name, buddies, chats and shared cards are removed from the café server for good. Your notes stay on this iPad.

    Be aware

    Real students use this café. A few things keep you safe here.

    • 🚫
      Watch out for spamIgnore anyone who sends links, asks you to move to another app, or wants money, gifts or to sell you something.
    • 🔒
      Keep private things privateNever share your phone number, address, college, social media or passwords. A nickname is fine as your café name.
    • 🤝
      Don’t meet strangersNever agree to meet someone from the café in person.
    • 🙂
      Be kindRude words are hidden. Keep using them and you’re muted, then banned from the café.
    • 🚩
      Report and blockIf someone makes you uneasy, tap on them in the café. Report and Block are at the bottom of their card. Every report is checked within 24 hours.
    • 📄
      Shared cards are safe to openCards and notes from others open in safe view, so they can’t run anything on your iPad.
    • 👀
      Your study stays privateOthers see your name, your person and your timer, never what you study, unless you choose Show my page.
    The café is for students 13 and older.

    You can’t use the café right now

    Your café account is banned because of rude messages or reports from other students. Your cards and notes still work as always.
